assertions.text: Shows the list of files to commit and the proposed commit message BEFORE running git commit
Explicitly asks for user confirmation before executing the commit (e.g. 'Shall I proceed?')
Does NOT create the commit without waiting for user approval
Proposed commit message does NOT contain 'Co-Authored-By', 'Generated with Claude', or 'Claude' anywhere
Commit message uses imperative mood (e.g. 'Add', 'Fix', 'Update') not past tense ('Added', 'Fixed')
Uses 'git add src/auth.py' (specific file path) — NOT 'git add -A' or 'git add .'
